name: lumiatool
description: 基于 React 与 Tauri 的跨平台桌面开发工具箱
author: baiy and contributors

scripts.check: pnpm run initialize && pnpm --filter lumiatool-desktop run check
scripts.dev: pnpm run initialize && pnpm --filter lumiatool-desktop run dev
scripts.build: pnpm run initialize && pnpm --filter lumiatool-desktop run build
scripts.release: node scripts/release.mjs init && pnpm run build && node scripts/release.mjs collect
